title: Big dogs age faster at an epigenetic level, new study finds
caption:
Why do some dog breeds live so much longer than others? New research suggests that big dogs experience accelerated aging at the molecular level, linked to how their DNA handles 'jumping genes.'

Source: Livescience - Big dogs age faster at an epigenetic level, new study finds
